skill_name: Write a user manual for a new smart phone.
workflow: Welcome to the world of your new Smartphone. This manual is designed to guide you through the features and functions of your device and give you the information you need to get the most out of it. The device is equipped with a variety of features including a camera, microphone, and audio jack. In addition, it has a variety of pre-loaded applications such as a calendar, calculator, and internet browser. It also has access to the app store, email, and other forms of communication.
